media.alt: Alma mater honours Dr Abdul Gaffar Billoo
Alma mater honours Dr Abdul Gaffar Billoo

content.text: Dr Abdul Gaffar Billoo, veteran paediatrician and professor emeritus at the Aga Khan University, Department of Paediatrics and Child Health, has been honoured by his alma mater, the Dow University of Health Sciences, which has named its auditorium after the legendary doctor.

A 1959 graduate of Dow Medical College, Karachi, Dr Billoo has been associated with AKU since 1998. From 1998 to 2004 he served as Chair, Department of Paediatrics; since 2005, Dr Billoo has continued as professor in the same department and was awarded professor emeritus status in 2012.
Dr Billoo has also aserved as the Chair of Paediatrics & Child Health at Dow Medical College and as Dean, Faculty of Medicine, Karachi University.

Reflecting on the honour, Dr Billoo said, "I feel humbled and honoured at this thoughtful gesture from my alma mater ... [given to me] in recognition of nine years of continuous service to the syndicate and selection board of the University."

Dr Billoo is the founder and Chairman of Health and Nutrition Development Society (HANDS), the largest NGO in the country. The organisation is involved in integrated community development in over 20,000 villages in 35 districts across the country utilizing the services of over 1700 employees and more than one million community based volunteers.
Dr Billoo was awarded the Sitara-i-Imtiaz in 2007 for public service. He also sits on the board of a number of medical and non-profit institutions.
